title: File claims on delivered shipments
body:
Customers can claim money back when something goes wrong with a delivered shipment.

Add a new module `parcelo/claims.py` with `file_claim(shipment_id, amount, reason)`. It stores a Claim with the fields `id`, `shipment_id`, `amount`, `reason` and `filed_at` in a new `db.claims` collection (add it to `parcelo/store.py` and clear it in `reset()`), and returns the claim.

Only delivered shipments can have claims. The shipment must exist, and the amount must be positive. Anything else must fail.
